race.comment: Good race with plenty of these in form. YOU SEXY THING (7) is flying and looks hard to beat on the seven-day turnaround. Beaten narrowly by AUSTRALIA FOREVER two back then was a huge winner on the Parks track a week ago, sitting second before clearing right out. Will be handy this longer trip and looks tough to rein in again. AUSTRALIA FOREVER (8) has the form coming through YOU SEXY THING and is another in great form. Looks sure to be winding up into the finish again. THERMODYNAMIC (6) is another going well including an all-the-way win on the Parks track latest. Low draw and will be in this for a long way. BRAVE STAR (2) is well placed and gets his chance to break through. FREEDOM FLAME (3) resumed in open class. Fitter and this is easier so can improve sharply.
